findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_fee_benchmarks · Private data: search_fee_only_advisors, get_advisor_profile, get_firm_profile · Public sink: search_fee_only_advisors, get_advisor_profile, get_firm_profile, get_fee_benchmarks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_fee_benchmarks · Private data: search_fee_only_advisors, get_advisor_profile, get_firm_profile · Public sink: search_fee_only_advisors, get_advisor_profile, get_firm_profile, get_fee_benchmarks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
